clauses.text: Faculty Monthly Fixed Remuneration (without any added allowance) Eligibility Criteria as per NMC

Should have at least four Research publications (at least two as Associate Professor) [only original papers, meta- analysis, systematic reviews, and case series that are published in journals indexed in Medline, PubMed, Central Science Citation Index, Science Citation Index, Expanded Embase,…
Faculty Monthly Fixed Remuneration (without any added allowance) Eligibility Criteria as per NMC
Should have completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research from Institutions designated by NMC
Medical Colleges within the country, are eligible to apply as per eligibility criteria specified for each post.
All Candidates must have up-dated Medical (NMC/ State Medical Council) with all post MBBS/ MD/ MS Qualification(s)
Even after that, if, candidate is selected, they must have to submit updated Medical Registration Certificate on the time of reporting to join to the Meghalaya Medical Council (MMC).
Opportunity of interview given to candidates will be on provisional basis subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility criteria.
